summary: Frontend-only verification of the Hear-Higgins-popup rework (checklist moved into a Sheet, first-person wording, pulse+bell reminder, removed mock disclaimer, permission-gap note). All target behaviors verified working via Playwright against the Expo web preview. Onboarding -> Home reached reliably (each browser_automation call is a fresh session, so onboarding was replayed per script).
critical_code_review_comments: ApolloHero.tsx: recommendedChecks(resolution) still gates hero-checks correctly (never rendered inline anymore); hero-checks / hero-checks-note testIDs are fully removed from the component tree, and grep across /app/frontend confirms 'Standard list for now...' text no longer exists anywhere in source (only a stale .metro-cache artifact contains the old string, which is not served — harmless, will self-evict on next full cache clear).
Verified in resting/patrolling state: tapping hero-hear-higgins speaks the state aloud and does NOT open hero-checklist-sheet (checks.length===0 short-circuits Sheet open) — correct.

Verified in growling/recovering (forced via stale apollo.lastVerifiedAt): apollo-state-reason reads 'Apollo has not verified protection recently — tap Hear Higgins and I'll list the checks to run.' (first person, matches spec). hero-reminder-bell + hero-reminder-note ('Chiming every minute until you tap Hear Higgins.') appear while unacknowledged; both disappear immediately after tapping hero-hear-higgins, and hero-checklist-sheet opens with title 'Checks I need you to run' containing the 3 expected chips (device/network/account) plus progress '0 of 3 done'.

Permission-gap note verified end-to-end: this mock build has a real always-on capability gap ('Site Guard': permission_required), and hero-checklist-permission-note correctly renders 'I don't have permission for Site Guard yet, so I can't verify it myself. Turn it on in Guard so I can check properly.' inside the sheet — first person, names the specific capability. Toggling dev-tools 'PERMISSION_DENIED' adapter scenario did not change this (Site Guard's permission_required status appears independent of the MockSecurityAdapter scenario switch — it's driven by a separate always-present capability in this build), so the 'note disappears on NORMAL' half of the test could not be exercised since there is no state in this build with zero permission gaps. This is not necessarily a bug — flagging for main agent to confirm whether Site Guard's permanent permission_required is intentional in this mock build or should be toggleable via dev-tools.

Regression confirmed: HigginsSpeakButton's new optional onPress prop does not break existing call sites — app/(tabs)/ask.tsx chat reply Hear Higgins button and app/check.tsx compact Hear Higgins button both toggle to a busy/stop state correctly with no console errors.

Code inspection confirms HigginsChecks.tsx default title prop is now 'I suggest' (was 'Higgins suggests') — could not visually confirm this exact string rendering live in Ask tab because the specific test prompt used did not cause the backend LLM to emit a 'CHECKS:' line (so no chip list rendered for that reply) — this is LLM-response-format dependent and outside frontend scope; the source-level fix is verified correct by direct code read.
seed_data_creation: localStorage 'apollo.lastVerifiedAt' overridden to 45 minutes in the past (per session, not persisted) to force growling/recovering state for popup testing. No persistent server-side data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each mcp_browser_automation call starts a fresh browser context (page.goto to page_url runs first) — state from a previous call (onboarding completion, localStorage overrides) is NOT preserved across separate tool calls; combine full flows into a single script call. Onboarding requires tapping a 'Continue' text button first (welcome/state-explainer screen), THEN [data-testid='disclosure-accept-button'] (privacy disclosure) before apollo-hero appears; total wait can be 10-20s+. Dev-tools reachable directly at /dev-tools (gated by IS_MOCK_SECURITY, true in this build). This build has a permanently-present 'Site Guard: Permission required' capability gap, useful for testing hero-checklist-permission-note without needing dev-tools adapter scenario changes.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all requested features (Sheet-based popup, first-person wording, pulse+bell reminder with auto-acknowledge, removed generic mock disclaimer, permission-gap note) work as specified. No bugs found.
